853:t_106:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Sexual harassment is no fun unless you fight back hard and get angry, $$ＭＩＸ$$!!」

853:t_106:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$アンディ$$, you idiot! Give me back my $$ＭＩＸ$$!」

853:t_106:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, that is it! That is what I was waiting for!!」

853:t_107:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... You aren't turning invisible! That is a good sign!」

853:t_107:6.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「I can't keep being timid forever either.」

853:t_107:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then allow me to test just how long your courage will last.」

853:t_107:8.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「I-I won't lose...! I... absolutely won't lose to the likes of you, $$ＡＧ$$!」

853:t_107:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ahh... Seeing you act brave even as you tremble with fear is the finest reward I could ask for!」

853:t_107:11.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「I-I knew it... You really are... scary, $$ＡＧ$$...」

853:t_108:4.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$. So, what is my extra prize?」

853:t_108:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have it all ready. Here... A data collection of secretly taken pictures of $c's pretty boys and girls!」

853:t_108:8.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Sorry, $$ＡＧ$$... I know I asked for it, but I'll pass.」

853:t_108:10.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「No, it's just that secretly taking pictures doesn't excite me unless I do it myself.」

853:t_108:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your dark side runs quite deep too, $$サザンカ$$...」

853:t_109:4.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. As ever, you are...」

853:t_109:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please wait! Musical terms are too difficult for me, so please use words I can understand!」

853:t_109:6.en:
$$シュレード$$
「I see... So you cannot feel the pulse born of the sounds filling the world woven by a piano's melody...」

853:t_109:7.en:
$$シュレード$$
「That is a shame. If the rhythm of your soul meshed with the rhythm of my life, their harmony would become a whisper of the heavenly beings.」

853:t_109:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Th-this is bad... I understand what he is saying even less now...)

853:t_109:9.en:
$$シュレード$$
「What I mean is... let us live freely, $$ＡＧ$$.」

853:t_109:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
($$シュレード$$ overturned his fate of death... I can feel the strength of life in his words.)

853:t_110:4.en:
$$クレア$$
「That smile... You are plotting something, aren't you?」

853:t_110:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no... I am not a cuckoo.」

853:t_110:10.en:
$$クレア$$
「I have not lived all these years for nothing.」

853:t_110:11.en:
$$クレア$$
「The same goes for you, doesn't it?」

853:t_110:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Uh... The odds seem to be against me...」

853:t_111:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What is it...? It is a celebration of your becoming an ace pilot. Didn't you have these in the $$人類銀河同盟$$?」

853:t_111:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I judge this to be equivalent to the privileges granted after completing the prescribed hours of military duty.」

853:t_111:7.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I infer that unrestricted sleep, eating and drinking, and reproduction will be permitted.」

853:t_111:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「N-no... I really cannot offer a $$欲求７７７$$ service where you can sleep, eat and do it all you want...!」

853:t_111:9.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have a question. Why, then, do you perform such an unproductive ritual?」

853:t_111:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Human joy exists outside rationality and efficiency. I hope that you can discover it, $$レド$$.」

853:t_111:14.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I understand the situation. This unit shares $$ＡＧ$$'s assessment.」
